verdict.rationale: Milvus's own docs include a tutorial for setting up an MCP server that lets AI applications run vector searches, manage collections and retrieve data through natural-language commands. A probe confirms an official MCP server repo at zilliztech/mcp-server-milvus, maintained by Milvus's corporate steward. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and documented details on its tool coverage, transport and auth setup.
